sources.content:
West Lake Hangzhou: Complete Text Content

Introduction
West Lake (西湖, Xī Hú) is more than just a body of water; it is the symbol of Hangzhou and a masterpiece of Chinese landscape design. It holds UNESCO World Heritage Site status and has inspired artists for over a thousand years.

Why Visit
Unlike many natural wonders that are purely wild, West Lake has been carefully shaped by human hands for centuries to reflect the ideal of Chinese aesthetics.

Top Ten Scenes & Attractions

Leifeng Pagoda (雷峰塔): A five-story pagoda on the southern shore offering panoramic views. The elevator reaches the top, ideal for sunset viewing. Historically significant in the White Snake legend.

The Broken Bridge (断桥): Located at the eastern end of Bai Causeway, famous for appearing "broken" when snow melts unevenly in winter. Associated with the legendary White Snake romance.

Three Pools Mirroring the Moon (三潭印月): The lake's largest island, featured on China's 1 RMB banknote. Stone pagodas are illuminated during Mid-Autumn Festival.

Su Causeway (苏堤): Built by the famous poet-governor Su Dongpo, this 2.8km causeway crosses the entire lake. Lined with willows and peach trees.

Lotus in the Breeze at Crooked Courtyard: Northwestern shore location, best for viewing lotus blooms July-August.

Activities

Boat Tours: Painted boats approximately 50-70 RMB. Rowboats: Private hand-rowed boats at approx. 150 RMB/hour. Self-rowing available in designated areas.

Cycling: The perimeter of West Lake is about 15km, making it perfect for cycling. Roads are well-paved. Bikes restricted on Su and Bai Causeways during peak hours/weekends.

Evening Show: Impressions West Lake directed by Zhang Yimou features lights, music, and hundreds of performers on the water's surface.

Tea Experience: Hangzhou is the home of Longjing (Dragon Well) Tea. Visit Meijiawu Tea Village or Longjing Village for authentic plantation experiences.

Food & Dining
West Lake Fish in Vinegar Gravy (西湖醋鱼): A signature sweet and sour freshwater fish dish.
Dongpo Pork (东坡肉): Braised pork belly named after the poet Su Dongpo.
Beggar's Chicken (叫化鸡): A whole chicken wrapped in lotus leaves and clay, then baked slowly.
Longjing Shrimp (龙井虾仁): Stir-fried river shrimp cooked with Longjing tea leaves.

Best Times to Visit
Spring (March-May): Peach blossoms and weeping willows bloom; pleasant weather.
Autumn (September-November): Cool air with osmanthus flowers everywhere.
Summer: Hot and humid, but lotus flowers are beautiful.
Winter: Cold temperatures; snow on Broken Bridge creates magical scenery.

Transportation & Access
Metro: Take Line 1 to Longxiangqiao Station (Exit C). You will be just steps away from the lake.
Bus: West Lake Loop Line (51/52) circles the lake.

Practical Tips
Avoiding Crowds: The lake is most serene at sunrise (around 5:30 - 6:00 AM). Avoid weekends and Chinese public holidays.
Tickets: Access to the West Lake scenic area itself is free. However, specific attractions like Leifeng Pagoda, Jingci Temple, and taking boat rides require purchased tickets.

Recommended Duration: At least one full day to leisurely explore the key sites, or two days if you want to visit the surrounding tea villages and temples.

sources.content:
West Lake Hangzhou: Complete Travel Guide Content

Overview & Basic Information
West Lake, also called Qiantang Lake, sits in western Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. The scenic area spans 6.38 square kilometers and was designated a UNESCO World Heritage site on June 24, 2011. The lake operates 24 hours daily with free entry to the main scenic area.

The Ten Scenic Spots
Su Causeway in Spring Dawn: Located on the west side, built by Song Dynasty official Su Dongpo. Features graceful willows and morning mist.
Curved Yard and Lotus Flowers: Northwest corner location famous for summer blooms.
Autumn Moon over the Peaceful Lake: Western end of Bai Causeway.
Broken Bridge and Snow: Eastern end of Bai Causeway.
Fish Viewing at Flower Harbor: South side of Su Causeway.
Willow Wharf and Warblers: Southeast location.
Three Pools Mirroring the Moon: Central lake island (Xiaoyingzhou), featured on China's 1-yuan note.
Twin Peaks Piercing the Clouds: Southern shore peaks.
Leifeng Pagoda Sunset: Southern shore pagoda.
Evening Bell of Nanping Mountain: Jingci Temple location.

Ticket Information
Main Scenic Area: Free entry, open 24 hours.
Three Pools Mirroring the Moon: Leisure Boat + Island ¥55 adults, ¥27.50 children. Painted Boat + Island ¥70 adults, ¥35 children. Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
Yue Fei Temple: ¥25 adults, ¥10 children.
Lake Circle Boat Tour: ¥50-90 depending on vessel type.

Transportation Access
From City Center: Metro Line 1 to West Lake Cultural Square Station (Exit A or D), then walk 10-15 minutes.
From Shanghai: High-speed train from Hongqiao Railway Station to Hangzhou East Station (1 hour, ¥100-180), then metro.
From Xiaoshan Airport: Taxi ~30-40 minutes (¥100-150), or Metro Line 1 (60 minutes, ¥4).

Photography Locations
Li'an Temple with red maples, I Heart You Pavilion near Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, Huagang Guanyu with Leifeng Pagoda backgrounds, Majiawu Viewing Platform for panoramic vistas, Baoshi Mountain for sunrise photography.

Dining Recommendations
Jiaou Tiancheng: West Lake lotus root powder with Longjing tea flavor (¥10/bowl).
Zhi Wei Guan: Tiaotou Cake with red bean paste (¥2.50).
Longxiang Bridge Stinky Tofu: Traditional street food.
Jie Cang Beef Pie: Cheese-stuffed beef pies with flaky crust.

sources.title: Hangzhou West Lake | Ultimate Guide to Visit Xi Hu (China)
sources.content:
Hangzhou West Lake | Ultimate Guide to Visit Xi Hu

West Lake is famous for its rich history, cultural depth, and breathtaking beauty, and has captivated travelers for centuries. On June 24, 2011, the West Lake Cultural Landscape was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site.

To avoid too many crowds, it is highly recommended not to go during peak tourist periods around Labor's Day Holiday or National Day Holiday. Spring is the best time to appreciate willows and peach flower. Spring offers pleasant temperatures around 10–20°C, and don't miss the cherry blossoms along Su Causeway from mid-March to early April.

Transportation: Take Metro Line 1 and get off at West Lake Cultural Square Station, use Exit A or Exit D. Tourist Bus Line 2 is a dedicated loop route for tourists.

The perimeter of West Lake is about 15km, making it perfect for cycling. You can rent a shared bike via Alipay from ¥6/hour. Avoid busy hours on weekends (10 AM–4 PM).

The best way to visit the West Lake in Hangzhou is to WALK your way round it. The West Lake is like a classic Chinese painting come to life: temple eaves peek between the trees that line the lake's edge, while wooden boats sail lazily through waters that seem to stretch as far the misty mountains in the distance.

West Lake Fish in Vinegar Gravy (西湖醋鱼) is the signature sweet and sour freshwater fish dish.

Suggested visit duration: 2-3 hours for main highlights, 3 hours for regular visit, 6 hours for in-depth visit.

sources.title: Visiting the West Lake in Hangzhou - Don't Stop Living
sources.content:
Visiting the West Lake in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China

The best way to visit the West Lake in Hangzhou is to WALK your way round it. Alternatively, you can walk, ride a bike, or take a cruise boat around the West Lake. You can either rent a bicycle or take a cruise boat around the West Lake.

The West Lake is like a classic Chinese painting come to life: temple eaves peek between the trees that line the lake's edge, while wooden boats (or sampans) sail lazily through waters that seem to stretch as far the misty mountains in the distance.

Spring (March to May) is an excellent time to enjoy early blooming flowers, particularly the peonies in Viewing Fish at Flower Harbor or the Su Causeway. You can also see plenty of foliage at the Longjing Tea Plantations.

You can visit places like Leifeng Pagoda and Lingyin Temple. West Lake is famous for its Ten Scenes (西湖十景), poetic names given to specific views. Three Pools Mirroring the Moon is the largest island in the lake and a classic image found on the 1 RMB banknote.

sources.title: Hangzhou West Lake (Xi Hu) - Facts, Attractions, Four Seasons & Visiting Routes
sources.content:
Hangzhou West Lake (Xi Hu) - Facts, Attractions, Four Seasons & Visiting Routes

West Lake is a large open lake area which welcomes tourists for free. However, admission fees will be charged to visit some scenic spots around.

The lake is open all day long.

There are several ways to explore West Lake: Walking/Cycling, by Boat (average fee 55-150 RMB depending on type), Battery Sightseeing Cars (circular route 40 RMB/person, sectional 10 RMB/person, operating 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, extended to 9:00 PM in summer).

You need 2-3 hours to see the main highlights. For a regular visit, 3 hours is recommended, and 6 hours for an in-depth visit.

sources.title: 西湖_百度百科
sources.content:
西湖信息总汇

基本信息
西湖位于中国浙江省杭州市西湖区，又名钱塘湖。湖面面积为6.38平方千米，汇水面积为21.22平方千米，为江南三大名湖之一。

地理位置与地形
西湖南、西、北三面环山，东邻城区。湖中白堤、苏堤、杨公堤、赵公堤将湖面分割成若干水面，湖中有三岛。西湖群山分为四个层次，海拔从50至400米依次抬升。

水文特征
流域内年径流量为1400万立方米，蓄水量近1400万立方米。湖体轮廓呈椭圆形，平均水深2.27米，最深约5米。天然地表水源包括金沙涧、龙泓涧、赤山涧、长桥溪四条溪流。

气候条件
地处中国东南丘陵边缘和亚热带北缘，年均气温16.2℃，年降水量约1500毫米，属亚热带季风性湿润气候。

景点与旅游资源
西湖有"西湖十景"、"新西湖十景"、"三评西湖十景"等著名景观，包括断桥、雷峰塔、苏堤春晓、花港观鱼等。有100多处公园景点，门票免费但景区内分景点需收费。

历史文化
西湖流传着《白蛇传》《梁山伯与祝英台》《苏小小》等民间传说。诗人白居易、杨万里、苏轼、辛弃疾等留下大量诗词。唐代白居易任杭州刺史时重修湖堤，完善了供水防洪工程。

资源状况
景区内有鸟类119种，哺乳类动物20余种。种子植物共有184科739属1369种，包含国家级保护植物。古树名木共620株，其中300年以上一级保护古树138株。

世界遗产地位
2011年6月24日，杭州西湖文化景观被列入《世界遗产名录》。2007年被评为国家AAAAA级旅游景区。

sources.title: 2026杭州西湖景区门票预约购买入口汇总
sources.content:
2026杭州西湖景区门票信息

西湖主景区门票免费，但园内部分景点需收费：雷峰塔40元、三潭印月20元、城隍阁30元、万松书院10元、玉皇山10元、太子湾公园10元、郭庄10元、六和塔20元、岳庙25元、灵隐飞来峰35元（现已免费）、黄龙洞15元、植物园10元、云松书舍5元。

西湖游船豪华船加三潭印月登岛的价格为：成人票70元、儿童票35元、学生票60元。

交通提示：杭州以"Y"字打头的公车都是旅游线，主要有Y2-Y9等线路，涵盖了所有西湖周围的景点，另外还有两条环西湖线：51、52。

特色美食：杭帮菜隶属中国八大菜系的浙菜，以"清爽别致"闻名，西湖醋鱼、片儿川面、杭州小笼包、东坡肉、葱包桧、叫化童子鸡等值得品尝。
